title: 6 Day Hypertrophy Priority Program
author: Lui L.
desc: A 6-day hypertrophy-focused program designed to maximize muscle growth while maintaining practical strength and function. Priority is given to upper chest, lats, calves, and shoulders, with additional emphasis on building stronger shoulders, glutes, core, and lower back. The program combines stable machine and cable work for high-quality hypertrophy with selected free-weight movements for strength, coordination, and stability.

variations.name: default
days: Push A - Upper Chest + Shoulder Strength
Push B - Upper Chest + Delt Hypertrophy
Legs A - Quads + Glutes + Calves + Core
Pull B - Lats + Back + Lower Back
Legs B - Glutes + Hamstrings + Calves + Core
